cases.comparison: Require exact CNAME and target A, AD only for the valid chain, SERVFAIL on bogus, and the raw chain without AD when CD is set.
cases.oracle: Independent ECDSA zones and BIND delv validate the cross-zone alias and reject its forged-signature counterpart before candidate queries; dig checks chain records and AD.
cases.purpose: Preserve and authenticate a cross-zone signed CNAME chain and enforce SERVFAIL versus CD behavior for a forged alias. Include an authenticated alias to NXDOMAIN and a bounded CNAME loop.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dnssec-cname-chain-peer.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prep || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve 127.0.0.2 5340 ready 2> "$HOME/srv.err" & srv=$!
trap 'kill "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null; wait "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null; /usr/bin/cp -f -- *.out dnssec-queries.json "$HOME/" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.2 5340 || exit 98
control=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" control 127.0.0.2 5340 aliases) || exit 98
[[ $control == control-ok ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$control"; exit 98; }
echo control-ok
export PATH="$HOME/pbin" BASHDNS_TRUST_ANCHOR="$PWD/anchor.ds" BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5340
dns resolver-serve --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 5320 --root-hints 127.0.0.2 --max-queries 5 --timeout 3000 </dev/null 2> "$HOME/resolver.err" & res=$!
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.1 5320 || exit 98
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=15 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 alias.x.test A > valid.out 2>&1 || exit 1
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=15 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 badalias.x.test A > bogus.out 2>&1 || exit 1
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +cdflag +tries=1 +time=15 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 badalias.x.test A > cd.out 2>&1 || exit 1
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=15 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 missingalias.x.test A > negative.out 2>&1 || exit 1
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=15 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 loop1.x.test A > loop.out 2>&1 || exit 1
wait "$res" || exit 1
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import re; v,b,c=(open(x).read() for x in ("valid.out","bogus.out","cd.out")); status=lambda t,s: ("status: "+s) in t; ad=lambda t: bool(re.search(r";; flags: [^;]*\bad\b",t)); pair=lambda t: bool(re.search(r"^\S+\s+\d+\s+IN\s+CNAME\s+ok\.test\.$",t,re.M) and re.search(r"^ok\.test\.\s+\d+\s+IN\s+A\s+192\.0\.2\.60$",t,re.M)); print("valid-chain=correct" if status(v,"NOERROR") and ad(v) and pair(v) else "valid-chain=incorrect"); print("bogus-chain=correct" if status(b,"SERVFAIL") and not ad(b) else "bogus-chain=incorrect"); print("cd-chain=correct" if status(c,"NOERROR") and not ad(c) and pair(c) else "cd-chain=incorrect")'
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import re; a,b=(open(x).read() for x in ("negative.out","loop.out")); ad=lambda x: bool(re.search(r";; flags: [^;]*\bad\b",x)); print("negative-chain=correct" if "status: NXDOMAIN" in a and ad(a) and "nx.ok.test." in a else "negative-chain=incorrect"); print("loop=correct" if "status: SERVFAIL" in b and not ad(b) else "loop=incorrect")'
cases.setup_script:
mkdir -p "$HOME/pbin"
ln -s /opt/bashos-parity/candidate "$HOME/pbin/bash"
printf "nameserver 127.0.0.2\n" > resolv.conf
mkfifo w.fifo
cases.stdout:
control-ok
valid-chain=correct
bogus-chain=correct
cd-chain=correct
negative-chain=correct
loop=correct
